paths.title: Don't Know Where to Start?
paths.subtitle: That's exactly why learning paths exist. Whether you just took your Shahada or you've been Muslim for years, these step-by-step guides take the guesswork out of learning. Pick a path, follow along, and grow at your own pace — no confusion, no overwhelm.
paths.reason1: Each path is carefully designed by educators to guide you in the right order — so you always know what to learn next.
paths.reason2: See exactly where you are, what you've completed, and what's coming next. Your progress is saved automatically.
paths.reason3: Whether you want to learn to pray, understand the Quran, or explore Islamic history — there's a path for that.

legal.privacyDescription: How Basmet Dawah collects, uses, and protects your personal information.
legal.termsDescription: The terms and conditions governing your use of Basmet Dawah.

privacy.introText: Basmet Dawah ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you use our platform at basmetdawah.com.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect information that you provide directly to us:
privacy.collectItem1: Account information: your name, email address, and password when you create an account.
privacy.collectItem2: Profile preferences: your preferred language and user type (new Muslim or mentor).
privacy.collectItem3: Learning data: your progress through lessons, quiz scores, bookmarks, and completed topics.
privacy.collectItem4: Communications: messages you send through the mentorship feature.
privacy.useIntro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.useItem1: Provide, maintain, and improve the platform and your learning experience.
privacy.useItem2: Track your progress through learning paths, lessons, and quizzes.
privacy.useItem3: Match you with a mentor if you request one.
privacy.useItem4: Send you important updates about your account or changes to our services.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your name and email with your assigned mentor if you request mentorship. We use Google Analytics to understand how users interact with our platform — this data is anonymized and aggregated.
privacy.cookiesText: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and remember your preferences. We also use Google Analytics cookies to understand usage patterns. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, though this may affect your ability to use certain features.
privacy.securityText: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information, including encrypting passwords and using secure HTTPS connections. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.childrenText: Basmet Dawah is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can delete it.
privacy.rightsItem1: Access, update, or delete your personal information through your profile settings.
privacy.rightsItem2: Request a copy of the data we hold about you.
privacy.rightsItem3: Delete your account by contacting us at the email below.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@basmetdawah.com.

terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using Basmet Dawah ("the platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the platform.
terms.descriptionText: Basmet Dawah is a free educational platform that provides structured Islamic learning content for new Muslims and anyone interested in learning about Islam. The platform offers learning paths, lessons, quizzes, topic browsing, and optional mentorship matching.
terms.accountsIntro: When you create an account, you agree to:
terms.accountsItem2: Keep your password secure and not share your account with others.
terms.accountsItem3: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
terms.conductItem1: Use the platform for any unlawful purpose or in violation of these terms.
terms.conductItem2: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the platform.
terms.conductItem3: Interfere with or disrupt the platform or its servers.
terms.conductItem4: Use the mentorship feature to harass, spam, or engage in inappropriate behavior.
terms.contentText: The content on Basmet Dawah is provided for educational purposes. While we strive for accuracy and rely on knowledgeable educators, the content should not be considered a substitute for guidance from qualified Islamic scholars. We encourage users to verify important religious matters with trusted local scholars.
terms.ipText: All content, design, and materials on Basmet Dawah are owned by us or our content contributors and are protected by copyright laws. You may access and use the content for personal, non-commercial educational purposes. You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works from our content without written permission.
terms.mentorshipText: The mentorship feature connects new Muslims with volunteer mentors. We facilitate the connection but are not responsible for the advice or guidance provided by individual mentors. Mentors are volunteers and their views do not necessarily represent those of Basmet Dawah.
terms.disclaimerText: The platform is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, either express or implied. We do not guarantee that the platform will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of harmful components.
terms.limitationText: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Basmet Dawah shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of or inability to use the platform.
terms.terminationText: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these terms or engage in behavior that is harmful to other users or the platform. You may also delete your account at any time by contacting us.
terms.changesText: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at support@basmetdawah.com.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Have a question, suggestion, or just want to say hello? We'd love to hear from you.
contact.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what's on your mind...
contact.successMessage: Thank you for reaching out. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
contact.errorDefault: Something went wrong. Please try again.
contact.errorRateLimit: You've sent too many messages. Please try again later.
contact.faq1a: Basmet Dawah is a free, multilingual learning platform designed for new Muslims. It offers structured learning paths, topic-based content, and quizzes to help you explore Islam at your own pace.
contact.faq2a: Yes, completely free. All content is available to everyone — no subscriptions, no hidden fees.
contact.faq3q: Do I need an account to access content?
contact.faq3a: You can browse all lessons and topics freely without an account. But we highly recommend creating one — it's free and lets you track your progress, save bookmarks, take quizzes, and pick up right where you left off.
contact.faq4a: English, Arabic, and Spanish — with full right-to-left (RTL) support for Arabic.
contact.faq5q: I found an error in a lesson. How do I report it?
contact.faq5a: Please use the contact form above or email us directly. We appreciate any corrections and will update the content promptly.
contact.faq6q: Can I contribute content or volunteer?
contact.faq6a: We'd love your help! Reach out through the contact form and let us know how you'd like to contribute.

footer.brand: A guided learning platform for new Muslims — explore Islam at your own pace.
